# Finzi AI

> Finzi AI is an AI accounting assistant for Indian accountants and small businesses. It reads bills (photos, PDFs, scans) and bank statements, extracts every field, and proposes ledger entries that a human approves before anything is saved. Made by FARATECH TECHNOLOGIES. Tagline: "Bills read. Payments matched. Books honest."

## What Finzi AI does

- Reads bills: vendor, invoice number, date, sub-total, GST breakup and total — GST read exactly as printed. If a total is not printed, Finzi calculates it and clearly asks the user to verify.
- Matches bank statements automatically; a client paying in instalments is shown honestly as a Partial Payment, never wrongly marked "fully paid".
- Approval-first by design: every extracted field is shown beside the original document, and nothing enters the books without the user approving it.
- Answers report questions in plain English and sends scheduled email reminders for due dates.
- Works in a browser on phone, tablet or laptop — no installation, no forms to fill in.
- Security: encrypted in transit, private sign-in-protected workspace, data never sold or shared.

## Who it is for

- Accounting practices and chartered accountants in India (primary; Finzi is built for their clients' books).
- Small and mid-sized businesses that want current, honest books without data entry.

## Pricing

- Try it free — your first bills are on us. No other pricing information is published yet.
